singlePurpose: Capture the user-selected web page as a full-page screenshot, edit it locally, and export the finished image or PDF.

permissionJustifications.activeTab: Used only after the user invokes Scrollout on the active tab. It allows the extension to capture visible page tiles and read the selected page title and hostname to label the temporary capture. It does not grant persistent access to all websites.
permissionJustifications.scripting: Injects a bundled, temporary capture script into the selected page. It measures the document, scrolls through the initial page area, handles fixed/sticky elements, and restores page styles and the original scroll position after capture or cancellation.
permissionJustifications.storage: Uses chrome.storage.session for capture coordination, browser-session identity, and editor ownership. Screenshot tiles, document metadata, and edits are held temporarily in the extension's local IndexedDB so the editor can reload and export. Data is not synced or sent to a server.
permissionJustifications.clipboardWrite: Writes a flattened PNG to the clipboard only when the user clicks Copy image in the editor. Scrollout does not read clipboard contents.

dataTypes.websiteContent: Screenshot pixels and user annotations, processed locally.
dataTypes.webHistory: Only the title and hostname of the page the user captures, for identifying that capture; no background browsing history.

dataUse: Only to provide the requested capture, local editor, temporary session restoration, and user-chosen export or clipboard copy.
transmission: No automatic transmission, sale, advertising, analytics, or server-side screenshot storage.
